name: roster-performance-tool
description: Standalone current-roster-performance dashboard, extracted from the Artist Relations Cockpit.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.app: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.ig:setup: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix server run ig:setup
